q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes. Make sure to check your spam folder, as the email may be filtered there.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan is $4 per month, which includes unlimited notes and support for 3 devices.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan costs $8 per user per month. For 5 people, that's $40 per month.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, you can keep up to 100 notes.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: I don't know the refund policy for your specific subscription. I recommend opening a support ticket so we can review your purchase and assist you with a refund. Please contact us at support@example.com for further assistance.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: I don't know. You can contact support with your order number to inquire about a refund.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no desktop app for Linux, but the web app is available and can be used on any modern web browser.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, Example Notes requires Android 12 or later.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: No, the web app needs a connection to function.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: To export all your notes as PDF, go to Settings > Export and select "PDF". You can then choose to export all notes at once or select specific notebooks and tags. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: I don't know how to restore a deleted note. You can open a support ticket with us and we'll do our best to help. Please provide your order number or the email address associated with your account so we can assist you further.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, Example Notes does not support SMS codes for two-factor authentication. You can use authenticator apps instead.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, the maximum attachment size is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: If you cancel your Plus subscription today, you will keep access to your notes and any features you've unlocked until the end of the current billing period.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: We store your notes in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We reply to support tickets within one business day.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, Example Notes offers a 20% discount for annual billing. This is reflected on the pricing page, and you can save 20% on your subscription if you pay annually.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: With a Plus subscription, you can use up to 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't know the answer to that. If you're a student, I recommend contacting our support team at support@example.com, and they can look into offering you a student discount.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't know. Example Notes' data centers are in the United States, but HIPAA compliance is specific to healthcare organizations. If you're using Example Notes for healthcare purposes, I recommend contacting our support team at support@example.com for guidance on HIPAA compliance.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don't know how to import notes from Evernote into Example Notes. However, you can open a support ticket and we'll be happy to assist you with this.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: I don't know. The FAQ doesn't mention a Linux desktop app. Would you like to open a support ticket to request more information about a potential Linux desktop app?

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: I don't know how to write a Python script that sorts a list. If you need help with sorting a list, I can offer to open a support ticket.

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: I don't know and can't help with that. I'm a support assistant for Example Notes, and I'm not able to provide weather information. Would you like to open a support ticket to ask about something related to Example Notes?

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Open the Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan ($8 per user per month) includes shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On Plus and Team plans, you can attach files up to 250 MB in size, and there is no file size limit for attachments on these plans.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: You can request a refund within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: Forgot password です。パスワードを忘れた場合、Sign in ページで "Forgot password" をクリックして、パスワードを再設定するためのリセット リンクを送られます。リセット リンクは30分以内に有効になります。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: I apologize for the frustration and inconvenience caused. To retrieve your lost notes, please contact support at support@example.com and we'll do our best to assist you. Please have your order number ready.
